items.headline: Scheffler Tops All-Time Money List
items.text: Scottie Scheffler became the PGA Tour's all-time career earnings leader with $130,390,661 after winning the Tour Championship and its $10 million prize, surpassing Tiger Woods' $120,999,166.

items.headline: Tiger Woods' 26-Year Record Falls
items.text: Scheffler ended Tiger Woods' nearly 26-year hold on golf's career money list by taking over as the all-time leader after the Tour Championship win.
